applicationSecret: Use for 20 minutes on clean skin. Select the desired LED light color according to your skin needs. Use 3–4 times per week.

lightFunctions.heading: LED & NIR Light Functions

items.name: Anti-Dark Spots Light

items.name: Imperfections Light

items.name: Energizing Light

items.name: Healing Detox Light
